portal.title: Government eServices
portal.subtitle: Republic of Benin — digital public services portal
portal.hero.title: Access public and utility services with your digital identity wallet
portal.hero.text: No passwords. Share only the verified information each service needs, directly from your wallet, using OpenID for Verifiable Presentations.
portal.bedc.name: BEDC Electricity PLC
portal.bedc.desc: View your electricity account, bills, meter readings and payments.
portal.fda.name: FDA Benin — Ministry of Health
portal.fda.desc: Access your health authority profile, appointments and vaccination record.
portal.how.title: How it works
portal.how.1.title: Choose a service
portal.how.1.text: Select the organisation you want to access.
portal.how.2.title: Scan with your wallet
portal.how.2.text: Scan the QR code, or open your wallet on this device.
portal.how.3.title: Approve and continue
portal.how.3.text: Review the requested data, approve, and you are signed in.
login.title: Sign in with your digital identity wallet
login.intro: Scan this QR code with your EUDI-compatible wallet to share your {credential}.
login.wallet_connected: Wallet connected — approve the request in your wallet…
login.rejected: The presentation could not be accepted.
login.requested_note: Only these attributes are requested. Nothing is stored after you sign out.
login.purpose.bedc: Identify the account holder before granting access to the electricity account.
login.purpose.fda: Confirm identity and date of birth from the civil registry before granting access to health services.
login.demo_note: Presents demo credentials signed by a simulated ANIP issuer.
login.no_wallet: Don't have a wallet yet? Ask ANIP how to obtain your digital identity.
login.show_link: Trouble scanning? Show the wallet link

bedc.login.heading: Customer portal
bedc.welcome_sub: Your identity was verified with your national digital ID (PID). Here is your electricity account overview.

wt.title: Wallet compatibility test
wt.intro: Each QR code below is the same {credential} request, sent in a different way. Scan them one at a time with your wallet: the card shows how far the wallet got, and the working variant tells you which settings to use.
wt.variant.legacy: Everything in the QR code (like the original test RP)
wt.step.request_fetched: Wallet fetched the request — waiting for its answer
wt.settings: Render environment variables for this variant:
wt.hint: Nothing changes on any card? The wallet is not opening the link at all: check its deep-link scheme (WALLET_SCHEME) and the Render logs.
